column1: # The level 2 template table (bead tla-7xql.5, epic tla-7xql).
# A template is a named family of items with one generating idea. The grouping
# matters because bead tla-7xql.1, the stem-blind gate, runs PER TEMPLATE: the
# artifact it hunts is template-local, and a pooled number hides a bad template
# behind good ones. So the template is a column in swipe/level2/ITEMS.tsv and
# not a comment.
# Rows are tab-delimited and carry the literal marker TPL in field 1, so prose
# in this file can never be read as data. Read rows with awk -F'\t' or cut,
# never with IFS=$'\t' read: tab is IFS whitespace, so a run of tabs collapses
# and an empty field vanishes.
# A TPL ROW. Five fields, in order, and they are level 0's and level 1's five:
#   1  marker      the literal TPL
#   2  id          S1 and up, stable, never renumbered
#   3  name        three or four words
#   4  idea        the generating idea, one sentence
#   5  calibration the reading/ models the family was shaped against
#   awk -F'\t' '$1 == "TPL" && $2 == "S1"' swipe/level2/TEMPLATES.tsv
#   grep '^TPL' swipe/level2/TEMPLATES.tsv | cut -f2,3
# THE IDS ARE S-PREFIXED. Level 0's five are T1 to T5 and level 1's pilot is
# E1. A level 2 template sharing one of those ids would make a pooled reading
# of the corpora silently merge families that have nothing to do with each
# other. The stem-blind instrument takes --items, so pointing it at the wrong
# table is one flag away and the id is what catches it.
# ONE TEMPLATE SHIPS HERE, ON PURPOSE. Bead tla-7xql.5 scopes this rung to
# machinery, a gate and one complete template as a pilot, the same scope level
# 1 had. How many templates level 2 wants is a decision the pilot informs
# rather than takes, and swipe/README.md carries the proposal.
TPL
column4: Ask whether a step formula holds across the pinned step, where the trap is that the subscript decides whether the action is tested at all: a subscript that does not move satisfies the claim by stuttering whatever the action says, a subscript that moves puts the action on the hook, and dropping the box or the subscript stops the line being a formula.
